videos_per_prompt: all manifest videos, no score-based selection

bootstrap.unit: source prompt family; connected source components for cross-paired labels

missing_outputs: retain all frozen items; missing/invalid scores zero; report coverage and conditional scores separately

spatial.expectation: valid direction reverses on mirror and restores on joint prompt/video change
spatial.scoring: exact upstream unsigned geometry and box pairing for every scheme; signed geometry only as separately named ablation
spatial.base_failures: retain in full denominator and separately report conditional valid-base sensitivity

objects.expectation: verified invisible target must fail conjunction; partial occlusion is not assumed to imply proportional score loss
objects.visibility: unverified endpoints reported as unverified, never counted as validated successes

scene.expectation: correct label and score unchanged under equivalent requirement
scene.ocean_to_sea: E0 dev diagnostic, explicitly separate from test
scene.official_target: auxiliary_info scene key; not full prompt
scene.model_aggregation: per-frame labels over the exact same 16 captions, insufficient reported as abstention

action.expectation: synonyms preserve class/score; verified absent replacement class should fail; OOV abstains
action.threshold_input: top-5 sigmoid confidence rounded to 4 decimal places, as upstream
action.other: outside scoring domain; never full credit; report known-class preservation for mixed outputs

tables: original videos by scheme and generator
paired original/transformed scores, violations and family CIs
scope_note: Small source counts, prior diagnostic exposure, annotation failures and invalid transformations must remain visible in the report. Model-annotated labels are not human gold.
